steps.what: Provide commentary and conduct interviews while observing the event and audience response

tasks.design: Keep live commentary and interviews with the announcer. Background material in {DOCS} supports preparation without replacing live interpretation and questioning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Commentary responds to unpredictable events and interview answers.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference tools support preparation but do not establish equivalent live interviewing.
tasks.still_hard: Timing, judgement and rapport change as the event unfolds.
tasks.human_edge: The announcer notices significant moments and asks relevant follow-up questions.
tasks.altitude: Live performance and editorial responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Follow-up questioning and verification under time pressure

evidence.claim: Live commentary and responsive interviewing remain human performance in this design; no measured automation benefit is established.

assumptions: Boundary is live commentary and interviews; separate background research and script preparation are not invented within this baseline.
The announcer directly observes events and hears interview responses during s1. No verified event-summary feed is assumed.
Use native access to existing background documents before custom tools; no new tool is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because live work is unchanged.
unknowns: Live format and existing preparation arrangements
research_questions: Is repeated background retrieval a distinct preparation task outside live performance?

incremental.description: No new live commentary automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Predictable ceremonies and rapidly changing sports both retain live observation and interviewing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Host broadcast civic and promotional events

steps.what: Host civic, charitable or promotional events for the broadcast audience

tasks.design: Keep hosting with the announcer. The event rundown in {DOCS} remains a reference for live transitions and interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hosting involves presence, audience interaction and handling changes during the event.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital rundowns support the host but do not replace the requested performance.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive moments and schedule changes need live judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The host creates rapport and responds to participants.
tasks.altitude: Hosting time and editorial responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate participant expectations for public events
reach.learn: Audience context and sensitive event communication

evidence.claim: A digital rundown supports but does not perform live event hosting.

assumptions: Boundary is on-air hosting, excluding production planning and separately assigned script composition.
Event producers provide the existing rundown and live cues in their normal production work. This design requests no new capture or structured cue feed.
Consider native rundown access before custom software; no additional system or recording requirement is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because the hosting workflow is unchanged; producer work remains unchanged and outside the focal denominator.
research_questions: Is host preparation distinct from live performance and already counted in another task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Scripted promotional segments and unscripted charitable events retain the host's performance.

steps.what: Research guest candidates and capture contact details against the show's editorial brief
Locate guest records matching specified topics and contact criteria
Assess guest suitability and contact selected candidates about appearing on the show

tasks.design: Configure a contact register and saved filters in {CRM}, populated from the announcer's checked guest research. The announcer retains editorial suitability checks and personal outreach through {EMAIL}; availability becomes known through that outreach.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches and sorting of known contacts consumed time after guest information had been gathered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contact fields and saved views can return exact matches without a model judging guest suitability.
tasks.still_hard: A relevant topic tag does not establish credibility, willingness or a good interview.
tasks.human_edge: The announcer identifies a worthwhile perspective and persuades guests to participate.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated contact filtering leaves research, editorial choices and relationships with the announcer.

reach.task: Assess sources for an interview topic
reach.learn: Source credibility and diversity of perspectives

evidence.claim: A native contact register with explicit fields can filter known guest records; suitability and outreach remain human and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers the announcer's research, matching and first outreach; guest time, final production booking and interview delivery are outside it.

The announcer produces in s1 name, verified contact route, source reference, checked topic tags, language, last-contact date and any contact restriction, plus required filters. Research and capture remain fully counted. Unknown fields remain unknown; empty matches or incomplete records trigger manual research.
Availability is not assumed before contact: the announcer requests and records it during s3, after selecting a candidate; a future search can use only a dated existing response.
Test native contact fields and saved filters before custom code. Existing automatic search runtime earns no saving; s2 represents repeated human filtering and assembling known records.
unknowns: Size and quality of existing guest contacts
Current duplication of research and sorting
research_questions: Do saved contact filters reduce repeat searches after paying for research, field capture and editorial checks?

already_counted.description: Suitability review and personal guest outreach

incremental.description: Maintain topic tags, contact restrictions and saved filters

approvals.approved_version: Exact guest, contact route, invitation wording and proposed appearance context checked before outreach in s3; changes require another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus7 upkeep gives net13. Range0-3 assumes few reusable contacts, incomplete tags and existing partial search automation; research and outreach retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Coordinate on-air games and contests by asking questions and interacting with participants
Check the competition outcome against rules and award prizes to the confirmed winner

tasks.design: Keep live competition interaction and outcome checking with the announcer. Rules and question material in {DOCS} support the live decision without assuming automatic interpretation of participants' responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competitions require live interaction and application of rules to actual responses.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing rule documents support checking but do not establish automated eligibility or winning outcomes.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous responses and disputed outcomes require clear judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The announcer maintains fair interaction and explains decisions to the audience.
tasks.altitude: Hosting and award responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clear participant expectations and dispute communication

evidence.claim: Live competition interaction and rule-based outcome judgement remain staff work in this unchanged design.

assumptions: Boundary covers live questions, interaction, outcome checking and announcing the award, excluding prize procurement or later fulfillment.
The announcer observes responses and produces the outcome in s1; s2 checks it before awarding. No free structured eligible-entry or correct-response field is assumed.
Use existing native document access before custom tools. Competition producers' existing rules and questions are unchanged; no new data capture is requested.
Zero incremental upkeep because no competition software or model is introduced.
unknowns: Who fulfills prizes after the broadcast
research_questions: Is any repeated scoring calculation separate from live interaction and already measured?

already_counted.description: Outcome check and prize award decision

approvals.approved_version: Exact response record, rule interpretation, winner and prize checked in s2 before announcement; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Clear quiz answers and disputed competition outcomes retain live interaction and outcome checking.

role.altitude: Known-contact filtering may shrink; commentary, hosting, interviews and competition decisions remain personal work.
reach: Coordinate clear participant expectations with public relations specialists
